title: UAMP signed delta fragment-group descriptor v1
$comment: Only a descriptor inside a verified delta/v2 envelope authorizes selecting these exact transport objects. Validate the digest of the canonical descriptor excluding group_id, sequential indices, summed bytes/counts, full ordered stream hash, UTF-8/canonical NDJSON, each current signature and complete dependency closure before one atomic admission. Schema validation alone establishes none of those. Groups carry memories, not executable authority.

record_bytes.description: Sum of canonical record bytes only, excluding proofs, wrappers and LF.

encoded_bytes.description: Sum of exact fragment bytes, including proofs, wrappers and LF; separate conservative transport ceiling.

records_sha256.description: SHA-256 of all raw fragment bytes concatenated in ascending fragment index order.

fragment_line.$comment: Serialize canonically as UTF-8 followed by exactly one LF. Never split a line across fragments; reject empty lines, noncanonical JSON, duplicate IDs and missing/unexpected proofs. File bounds include LF.
